summary: NexGen Energy Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting voting results from its annual general and special meeting held June 30, 2026. Shareholders elected all nine directors, with one nominee, Richard Patricio, receiving only 50.92% support and 49.08% withheld. This high level of opposition is a forced/abrupt board departure indicator, although Patricio was still elected. The meeting also approved a Shareholder Rights Agreement, auditor reappointment, and board size. The filing is a routine meeting report with a notable dissent vote, but not an activist campaign. Watch for potential subsequent board changes or shareholder pressure.
